exposure: other systemic involvement of connective tissue
cohort: 991,701 births in Australia from 2001 to 2011, including 409 births in women with rare autoimmune diseases
finding: Women with rare autoimmune diseases had higher rates of cesarean delivery, preterm birth, maternal complications, and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to the general obstetric population.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was significantly higher among women with rare autoimmune diseases compared to the general obstetric population (49% vs. 28%).
